video:video.video:title: Car rim laser stripped back to bare steel (time-lapse)
video:video.video:description: Time-lapse of a car rim going from old cream paint to bare steel with laser cleaning in Sydney. No sandblasting, no chemicals, no damage to the metal underneath.

video:video.video:title: 200W pulse laser lifting pitted rust out of a car panel
video:video.video:description: A 200W pulse laser cleaning pitted rust out of a sanded car panel. The laser reaches into the pits that sanding leaves behind, so the panel is ready to prime.

video:video.video:title: Rusty steel angle laser cleaned down one face
video:video.video:description: Laser rust removal on a steel angle in Sydney. One face is cleaned back to bright metal in a single pass so you can see the before and after side by side.

video:video.video:title: Stone step cleaned with a 200W pulse laser
video:video.video:description: Grime and staining lifted off a stone step with a 200W pulse laser. Laser cleaning works on stone and concrete without water blasting or harsh chemicals.

video:video.video:title: 1500W laser clearing fire soot off a concrete ceiling
video:video.video:description: Fire damage restoration in Sydney: a 1500W continuous laser clearing heavy fire soot off a concrete ceiling, with no water, chemicals or mess.

video:video.video:title: Laser removing soot damage from a balcony
video:video.video:description: Soot damage on a balcony that other cleaning methods could not shift. The laser lifted it off and left the surface intact.

video:video.video:title: Laser line clearing rust off a steel beam
video:video.video:description: Industrial laser rust removal on a steel beam, filmed on site in Sydney. The laser line strips rust back to bare steel ready for coating.

video:video.video:title: Long steel rail half cleaned with a laser
video:video.video:description: A long steel rail half laser cleaned, showing the rusty and cleaned sections side by side. On-site laser rust removal across Sydney.

video:video.video:title: Rusty steel rail cleaned in one pass
video:video.video:description: Laser cleaning a rusty steel rail back to bare metal in one pass. No sandblasting media to clean up and no damage to the steel.

video:video.video:title: Yellow paint laser stripped off a steel rail
video:video.video:description: Laser paint removal: yellow paint stripped off a steel rail in Sydney without grinding, chemicals or blasting.
